chunks: The venerable Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both). He said:
A man's supplication for his brother in his absence generates sustenance and repels hateful things.

key_terms.بظهر الغيب: In absence — praying for someone without their knowledge

ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of praying for others in their absence in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) teaches that praying for a fellow believer in their absence has two concrete benefits: it increases sustenance (rizq) and wards off harm. This was spoken in the context of encouraging brotherhood and mutual supplication among believers.
